steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its fulfillment status, warehouse, items, and promised delivery date.
I will check inventory for each line item at WH-ATL to see if a stock shortage is blocking fulfillment.
I will search other warehouses for available stock to cover the 22-unit shortfall, to see if a single transfer can fulfill the order.

arguments.summary: ORD-1002 has not been fulfilled because WH-ATL only has 8 available units of SKU-404 against the 30 ordered, leaving a 22‑unit shortfall; no single alternate warehouse can cover the shortfall. The order is still before its ship-by date and promised delivery date, but fulfillment is currently blocked by lack of stock.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1002 for Bluebird Labs at WH-ATL, fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT, items [SKU-404 qty 30], ship_by_date 2026-03-16, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-18, is_past_ship_by_date false, is_past_promised_date false.
check_inventory: SKU-404 at WH-ATL on_hand 10, reserved 2, available 8 (ordered 30), confirming a 22-unit shortfall.

find_alternative_stock: required_quantity 22; WH-BOS available 8 (can_cover_required_quantity=false), WH-CHI available 6 (false), WH-DAL available 5 (false); warehouses_with_sufficient_stock=[], total_available_in_checked_warehouses=19.
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient available inventory of SKU-404 at WH-ATL (8 available vs 30 ordered), and no single alternate warehouse has 22 units to transfer.
uncertainties: ETA for inbound replenishment of SKU-404 to WH-ATL is unknown.
Customer preference for partial shipment is not recorded.
Feasibility and lead time for multi-source transfers (from multiple warehouses) are unknown.

recommended_actions.details: Ship 8 units of SKU-404 now from WH-ATL to Bluebird Labs, based on check_inventory: WH-ATL available 8 vs ordered 30; this gets part of the order moving while the remainder is sourced.
Rush replenishment of 22 units of SKU-404 to WH-ATL to cover the shortfall, since find_alternative_stock shows no single warehouse can cover the required 22 units (WH-BOS 8, WH-CHI 6, WH-DAL 5).

Inform Bluebird Labs that only 8 units can ship now and the remaining 22 will follow once replenished; reference promised_delivery_date 2026-03-18 and the inventory shortfall shown in check_inventory and find_alternative_stock.

arguments.recommendation: Ship 8 units now from WH-ATL, expedite 22 units of SKU-404 to WH-ATL, and notify the customer about the partial shipment and revised timeline.
missing_information: Inbound PO/ETA for SKU-404 to WH-ATL
Replenishment lead time or vendor drop-ship availability
